text:
If He Who Must Paint You Must See You...\nIf he who must paint you must see you, and none can look without going blind, who will be able to portray you without offending his sight and you?

I wished to make you bloom in snow and roses; but that would honor roses and wrong you; I wished to give you two stars for eyes; but when did stars ever dream of it?

I knew the sketch impossible; but your mirror, by your own light, assured success in its reflection.

It can portray you without borrowed light, since in the mirror you yourself are original, painter, brush, and copy.

translation.title: To Aminta, Who Covered Her Eyes with Her Hand...
